media.transcript: I made a tiny printer that prints out text so you don't have to look at your phone. I had this idea this past weekend when I was trying to spend less time on my phone, and I thought it would be cool if you could get like a little printout of any time you got a new text so you'd know if someone's trying to reach you. I told that to Maggie when I got to Cat Labs the next day, and she reminded me that we have an old shipping label printer. So we plugged it into my computer, and I just opened up Claude code and was like, yo Claude, do you see this printer? If so, print me a message. And then this happened. Shut up. Oh my god! No! So that felt like literal witchcraft, but then we actually needed it to print text. So I just explained to Claude exactly what I wanted to happen. And anytime I got lost or didn't understand what it was doing, I would just ask questions along the way. It ran into some printing errors at first. And then when that happened, we just took a picture of the paper and uploaded it back into Claude and it was able to use that photo to diagnose and fix itself. Until about 15 minutes later when it started pulling my real texts and printing them out in real time. It was actually insane. But the most shocking part of all was when I told Claude I needed it to think about how it was going to handle text messages with media attachments, like links. And a few minutes later, we looked over at the printer and saw this. It took a real link that my friend had sent me to a Spotify song, turned it into a QR code, and then printed the QR code so I could scan it. I am so excited to play with this in real life, but I'm also wondering if other people would potentially want this too. We could for sure run a few prototypes of these and ship them out, so leave a comment below and feel free to join the waitlist in bio if you would be interested in that as well.

media.transcript: El nuevo Xiaomi marca el comienzo de una nueva era en los móviles. El primero fue Huawei con su pura X-Max hace ya dos años. Después, ¿quién vino? Vino Samsung con su Fold 8 hace apenas un mes. Y Apple presentará su iPhone Ultra el 9 de septiembre. Y Xiaomi, bueno, pretende superar a todos con su nuevo Xiaomi 18 Fold. Su presentación oficial es el 7 de septiembre, pero la marca ya ha desvelado prácticamente todos los detalles, incluido el vídeo que estás viendo en este vídeo. Un diseño sublime, o sea, me parece el pic de la tecnología actual. Y una cosa muy clara, demostrarle a todos, al resto, que se pueden hacer las cosas bien. El iPhone Ultra será bastante caro y solo tendrá dos cámaras con una batería pequeña. El Fold 8 de Samsung solo tiene dos cámaras y también tiene una batería pequeña. El modelo de Huawei está fantástico, pero no tiene la potencia necesaria para el precio que cuesta. Pues bueno, el Xiaomi 18 Fold lo tiene todo, ¿vale? Triple cámara trasera firmada por Leica, batería masiva de 6000 mAh, una potencia loca con el procesador X-Ring O3, este de fabricación propia, es una locura, inteligencia artificial... Eso sí, por desgracia y por algún extraño motivo, esta auténtica maravilla de la tecnología se queda solo en China. Ojalá rectifique. El iPhone Ultra

media.transcript: Sometimes the best kind of therapy is retail therapy, and that's why I'm taking myself on a solo shopping day. If you've been to SoHo, you know you can literally not get into Brand New Melville if you're trying to go on a weekend, so it was perfect and empty today. And I ended up leaving with a few things. And then I went to Zara, and honestly, they were lacking. Usually I find a lot of stuff, and I couldn't really find much. I thought I ate with this outfit, like I thought it was gonna be sick, and it ended up looking literally terrible. Same thing with this, I thought it was really cute, but it looked horrible on me, so that's a no. And then of course, on my way out, I saw this gorgeous dress, but didn't feel like trying it on. And then I went into Los Angeles Apparel, specifically for the boat neck tops. They are literally the best boat neck. If you've never been to LA Apparel, they have literally every single kind of basic. Grabbed some things, and I'm also scared of the mannequins in here, because they're so realistic. And then I went to Princess Polly, and I didn't really find anything. And then went to Joe and the Juice for some lunch. And then I ended the day with getting my favorite drink. So good and refreshing, and yeah, that was the perfect therapy for me. So good.
